notes.title: Small fix
notes.content:
- If no Ethernet Connection: a message will appear and you won't be able to get stuck infinitely when Hosting
- Made "Separate Controllers" default for MP instead of "Same Controller" (both are still available)

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
- Color Corrected some levels.
- Fixed Collision in Jungle level [i](could get stuck between boxes)[/i]
- Moved Camera closer to player
- Shorter Gem Text Value visibility-distance

notes.title: Balance Update
notes.content:
[h1] Gameplay Changes:[/h1]
    
    - [b]Booster Pads[/b] and [b]Mushrooms[/b] are temporarily disabled after use (30 second timer) (To avoid infinite loops)
    - [b]Combos[/b] capped to 30 per turn, after which the Koala gets [b]Exhausted [/b]and loses control (in Score Attack and One Shot Wonder)
    - [b]Combo Point Bonus[/b] capped to 100 (>20 Combo = 100p instead of 105, 110, 115 etc)
    - [b]Snow Cannon[/b] Auto-shoot timer adjusted (3 -> 5 sec)
    
  [h1]Levels:[/h1]
  
    - Small changes to Green Hills
    - Small changes to Jungle Jam
    - Small changes to Icy River
    - Small Changes to Wildlands
    - Small changes to Frogs Marsh
    
  
  [h1]Rebalance Challenges:[/h1]
  
    - Re-balanced some of the Platinum Achievements (Score Attack, One Shot Wonder)
    - Changed Gold Star: Merry Go Round (3000 -> 2800)


(Edit: Small bugfix that occurred after patch: Damage didn't count)
